text:
Dhanteras 2025: What To Buy For Good Luck And Prosperity, As Per Your Zodiac Sign
Curated By :
Last Updated:
Celebrate Dhanteras 2025 by buying the right item for your zodiac sign. Align your purchase with planetary energies to invite prosperity, luck, and positive vibes at home.
1/13
Dhanteras is an auspicious day when new beginnings meet prosperity. Traditionally, people buy gold, silver, or valuable items to invite wealth and positive energy into their homes. This Dhanteras 2025, make your purchases even more meaningful by aligning them with your zodiac sign. Siddharth S Kumaar, Chief Astrologer at NumroVani, shares insights based on planetary alignment for the day, helping you bring home the right item that resonates with your stars and amplifies fortune.
2/13
This Dhanteras is all about having a stable financial situation and taking action with a purpose. Choose things that will help you stay strong and motivated, such gold coins, copper kitchenware, or red-colored decorations. Buying a watch shows that you are growing and have good timing. Buying fitness equipment helps you focus your energy into strength and progress.
ADVERTISEMENT
3/13
This year, Taurus will be lucky if they have comfort and quality. Silver jewelry, brass cutlery, or beautiful home decor products will bring in a consistent stream of money. You can also get nice kitchenware, silk linens for your bed, or good cutlery that will make your home look and feel better. Each of these stands for long-term happiness and wealth.
4/13
Gemini will do well at Dhanteras when it comes to talking to others and being creative. Now is a great time to buy computers, mobile phones, or other technological devices that will help you get more done. Learning resources like books, pens, and other things are just as lucky. You can also bring home a wind chime or a silver keychain to get the energy in your space moving, flowing, and positive.
ADVERTISEMENT
5/13
People born under the sign of Cancer do better when they have options that promote peace and safety. You should acquire silver utensils, idols of Goddess Lakshmi or Lord Ganesha, or water containers. Things that have to do with home and family, such kitchen sets or indoor plants, can keep your emotions and finances stable. A pearl or silver coin will also help you feel peaceful and wealthy.
6/13
Leo's Dhanteras is all about finding balance and being thankful. Get gold jewelry, brass lamps, or beautiful mirrors that reflect light and good energy into your home. Things you use at work, like a new chair or a golden pen, can also help you grow and get noticed. Buy things that make you feel strong and sure of yourself.
ADVERTISEMENT
7/13
Virgo should only buy things that are useful and have a purpose. Things like silver kitchenware, health or fitness equipment, or pure cotton bedsheets would bring you good luck. Stationery, diaries, or calendars that help you get more done are also good. A simple, elegant piece of jewelry stands for consistent growth in both money and personal development.
8/13
Libra can start fresh and look beautiful this year on Dhanteras. Choose home decor, artistic lamps, or stylish ornaments in copper or gold tones that will make your area feel better. It's also lucky to get new clothes, perfumes, or cosmetics that make you look and feel good. Pick things that show balance, style, and ease of mind.
ADVERTISEMENT
9/13
Scorpio likes spiritual progress and emotional strength. You can bring home sacred things like rudraksha malas, silver coins, or copper idols. You can also acquire spiritual literature, incense holders, or diyas to help you feel more at peace. A new locker or safe is also a good sign because it indicates protection and permanent prosperity.
10/13
Sagittarius does best when they study and explore new things. It's a good idea to buy books, travel gear, or gadgets that help you learn and grow. Gold jewelry or brass kitchenware provide good luck. Decorative globes, maps, or pieces of art that represent travel and inspiration also bring success and good luck.
ADVERTISEMENT
11/13
Capricorn should pick items that are useful and will last a long time. A new wallet, silver utensils, or a classic watch will help your money increase steadily. You can also buy savings tools or something that stands for stability, such a locker or a business item. A desk lamp or office chair might help you stay focused and do well at work.
12/13
Aquarius is lucky when it comes to new ideas and modern luxuries. Smart home devices, gadgets, or technology are great things to buy. You might like silver jewelry, wind chimes, or eco-friendly products since they fit with your futuristic way of thinking. Pick things that are both useful and new; they'll provide you both money and piece of mind.
ADVERTISEMENT
13/13
Pisces should work on finding tranquility, spirituality, and emotional equilibrium. Using silver utensils, gems, or holy icons is very lucky. Essential oils, lamps, or calming home design can help make your house more peaceful. You can also buy a yellow sapphire or pearl this Dhanteras to bring in money and cure your heart.
